endpoint_weight.evidence: Vendor API documentation for /time_series (twelvedata.com/docs, accessed 2026-10-13) states the endpoint's API credits cost as 1 per symbol. One symbol per request in this manifest, so 1 credit per request.

retention.condition: Retain downloaded Data only while the subscription remains active (Terms of Use, last updated January 1, 2026, as read 2026-10-13: retention limited to the duration permitted by the subscription, sec. 16.1; internal-use storage granted, sec. 2.2(a)); upon termination or expiration ALL Data must be deleted within 30 days (sec. 16.2) — the 30-day post-termination deletion condition. No indefinite or post-termination retention is claimed. Raw payloads are private, never published.
